title: Perfect support during personal crises
body: First I used the app when I was working more than 50 hours a week and needed additional support to take care of myself. Now I am living a nomadic life and everything is constantly changing . This app reminds me to still stick to good habits.
author: Veroniqqque

title: May be it’s a good app BUT….
body: it sends me notifications early in the morning when I sleep. And I can’t turn it off in app settings, I can only turn off “journey” notifications, but notifications from “moderator” I can’t change. So it wakes me up every three days…. So I decided to uninstall it
